changes.comment: Promote RebaseManager abort, resume, dispose, rebase events, setCustomHandler, merge state, and RebaseHandler (including recompute, dispose, and shouldReinstate) from @alpha to @beta. Promote TxnManager.rebaser from @internal to @beta. Promote TxnManager.withIndirectTxnMode, withIndirectTxnModeAsync, getMode, getTxnProps, queryTxns, getLastSavedTxnProps, and TxnMode from @alpha to @beta. Mark RebaseManager.resumeSemantic, onConflict, addConflictHandler, and removeConflictHandler as @internal because they depend on internal types.
